summary: Today the facts hold one family, the baselines: 117 settled trades, 64 wins, net P&L 88973.14, return 0.76%. No rule or AI family and no head-to-head pick rule is in today's facts, so no rule-versus-AI comparison can be made. Pattern across the items: all five biggest wins are always-up trades, four of them driven mostly by sector lift (ADANIPORTS, INDIGO twice, DRREDDY) and one by company-specific moves (INFY). The misses are small by comparison, about -2% to -3% each; three are RELIANCE trades hit by a sector drag while the market part was positive, and TCS and TATASTEEL were company-specific. Targets were reached in every item.
